asc_inceleme_notu_en: Version 1.75: fixes a crash when the app is opened by tapping a notification. Route videos are rendered on the device when the user taps Create video on a ride and can be saved to Photos; nothing is uploaded to our servers. The app is a paid app with no in-app purchases. Profile > Language lets the user pick the app language. Sign in with Apple to test.
